detail: Finish times outside 14–45 min dropped as incomplete or not 5 km
Junior varsity, Varsity B, and middle school events excluded
Star/depth from the seven fastest recorded varsity times per school; extra finishers in mixed dumps ignored
Invitational SOS not ingested; WCAC is only a coarse proxy
Regression requires five finishers so a fifth-runner z-score exists
Estimation/holdout require a prior parsed championship for the same school
2021 uses 2019 as the prior championship because 2020 is omitted
Names not in data/schools.csv dropped; see unmapped_schools.json
Posted team place used when available; reconstructed ranks break remaining ties by score then school name
